headline: Israel Vote Leaves Coalition Unclear
what: Israeli votes were still being counted after exit polls showed no bloc with a governing majority.
context: Coalition talks may take weeks while the region faces renewed conflict risk.
why_it_matters: Political uncertainty can affect regional security, energy routes, and oil prices watched by U.S. markets.

headline: Asian Chip Shares Surge
what: South Korea’s KOSPI jumped 6.6%, while Japan’s Nikkei 225 gained 1.3%.
context: Large chipmakers led the advance before major U.S. technology companies report results.
why_it_matters: Asian chip shares provide an early read on global demand for semiconductors and AI equipment.

headline: European Protests Strain Budgets
what: Cost-of-living, housing, and public-service protests continued across several European countries.
context: France faces weak growth, high public debt, and difficult budget choices.
why_it_matters: Prolonged unrest can interrupt commerce and raise borrowing costs for European governments and companies.
